verses.pali: Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Seated to one side, Venerable Rādha said to the Buddha:
“Sir, they speak of a ‘liability to end’.
What has a liability to end?”

verses.pali: “Rūpaṁ kho, rādha, khayadhammo, vedanā khayadhammo, saññā khayadhammo, saṅkhārā khayadhammo, viññāṇaṁ khayadhammo.
verses.english: “Rādha, form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness have a liability to end.
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
